scope: PostgreSQL enum-array array_sample and array_shuffle type resolution, randomized multiset invariants and result shape under a shadowed search_path
assertions: Untyped array_sample($1, n) and array_shuffle($1) calls return PostgreSQL SQLSTATE 42804; qualified enum[] casts remain bound to the target enum with a same-named shadow enum first in search_path.

Twenty-four repeated 1D samples at each size 0, 1, 3, and 6 preserve sample cardinality and never select any label or NULL more times than it occurs in the input; the test makes no fixed-order assertion.
Thirty-two repeated 1D shuffles preserve the full multiset, including duplicate labels and SQL NULL, with result type and shape checked against native calls.
Repeated 2D samples and shuffles return whole first-dimension slices with the expected dimensions and JSON values, without assuming which valid random ordering occurs.
Empty arrays remain empty; SQL NULL arrays return SQL NULL with the target enum-array type; requesting 7 items from a 6-item first dimension returns SQLSTATE 22023.
A shadow-only enum label is rejected with PostgreSQL SQLSTATE 22P02.
